title: Known SMO/SAN workflow envelope, independently scored PC/PS2
notes: User-requested accounting reset. Explicit class lists include unassessed frontier, not just easy/reconstructed classes. Each registered class has weight1, deduplicated across groups. Unrated contributes no credited evidence but remains in denominator; it is not proof of no historical knowledge. Presence does not confer behavior evidence. This is a versioned current-known envelope, NOT a proven complete call graph or remaining-work estimate. New discoveries require a new scope version/delta, never silent shrinking. Third-party OS/Direct3D/CRT implementation is out of scope; native boundary contracts remain required. Legacy direct37 and class scores remain separately available.

gates.title: Инвентаризация и замыкание зависимостей
gates.acceptance: Every admitted class/helper/field/branch and caller/callee relevant to PC SMO/SAN classified; all candidate edges resolved; no unidentified required body.
gates.current: v2 known envelope311 union/279PC/245PS2, all v1 members retained plus three original PC shader-template/parser classes. Complete reachable inventory not yet proved.

gates.title: Полная загрузка
gates.acceptance: Original and reconstructed whole-file loaders agree on representative PC SMO/SAN families, all supported variants and shared/external references.
gates.current: Whole bbush SAN and constructed mesh files pass; complete real textured/skinned/level SMO graphs and external-source paths remain open.

gates.title: Полное нативное сохранение
gates.acceptance: Whole native save dispatch/FAT/offsets/indexing plus all payloads and graph references are reproduced; original loader accepts reconstructed exports; unknown preservation specified.
gates.current: Field/reference writers and native texture writer pass; whole native FFPS save and optimizer batching, lossless unknowns remain open.

gates.title: Обработка загруженных данных
gates.acceptance: Transforms, animation, skin, all included scene/visibility/material/mesh and nonvisual consumers match original PC paths.
gates.current: CP19–49 adds material/texture controllers, all22 bounded shader constants, light payload, cached weighted geometry submission and matrix invalidation. Compiler/template/full-scene and protected paths still open.

gates.title: Владение и отказы
gates.acceptance: Multi-resource alias/reload/clone/rebind/delete plus representative failure boundaries are covered across the full supported graph; host/native differences explicit.
gates.current: Many local native hazards verified; graph-wide recovery, remaining reinit/clone/errors and borrowed lifetime remain open.

gates.title: Полная воспроизводимая сверка
gates.acceptance: All required behaviors linked to executable hashes/addresses and reproducible fixtures or bounded static proof, full clean-build regression; capped paths not counted as passed.
gates.current: CP49 verified build76/76,51/51CTest and3 exact37native parameter-append comparisons; preceding checkpoint reports preserved. Full all-required-behavior regression remains partial.

gates.title: Сквозной вывод PC
gates.acceptance: Safe real PC resource-to-scene-to-backend validation, including representative models, animation and level objects; COM-only fixtures insufficient.
gates.current: No completed live backend integration witness for the reconstructed complete pipeline; game/GPU not run in this audit.

unregisteredObligations.label: Native containers, name pool, allocator and singleton-support ABI
Plane storage, polygon clipping and protected dispatch
Pixel conversion/missing-mip generation and library boundary
Native shader compiler/reflection boundary and generated bytecode ownership

exclusions: Audio, input devices, networking and unrelated game logic are not admitted merely because engine startup references their registrations. If an actual SMO/SAN path requires one, add that dependency explicitly. PC goal does not require implementing PS2 backend. Game-boundary classes admitted here are not the whole game catalog.

Retain every previous member, add these three PC-only classes without scores; add explicit non-RTTI compiler/reflection boundary obligation. See docs/research/native-pc-shader-template-frontier.md.
